decision: Selected the Ryhti reference point of permanent building 104296229F, the 37,297 m2 three-storey new building of Lahti permit 302412792B (decided 15 September 2026) on property 398-17-9900-6 at Vartiokallionkatu 2, Kujala, as the project locator for the planned ecogrid.energy / Peab data centre. It locates that building's register point; it is not a footprint, the Peab lot, the quarry or a works extent.

selected_properties.main_purpose: code 02 (office, production, utility and other buildings)

identity_bridge: City of Lahti news of 25 August 2026 (FAQ added 26 August): a new data centre is planned in the Kujala industrial area, developed by ecogrid.energy Oy and Peab; applications for a building permit and a deviation permit have been filed; the data centre will be built east of Karistonkatu on a lot owned by Peab (a former asphalt plant) at Vartiokallionkatu 2, where Peab runs a gravel quarry.

Ryhti: Lahti permit 302412792B, decided 15 September 2026 (three weeks after the news), on property 39801709900006 (398-17-9900-6) records four new buildings, all addressed Vartiokallionkatu 2, 15160 Lahti and still planned: a three-storey building of 37,297 m2 / 222,080 m3 and buildings of 871, 248 and 89 m2. That property carries no other Ryhti building records, and the only other Ryhti addresses on Vartiokallionkatu are three older records at no. 2 and three at no. 1 (modified November 2025).

Ryhti does not name the applicant or the use; the identification of permit 302412792B as the data-centre permit rests on the exact address, the timing after the city's report of the filed building-permit application, and the data-centre scale of the main building.

consistency_checks.pyproj_check_note: Independent EPSG:3067 to WGS84 transform (pyproj 3.7.1, PROJ 9.5.1, always_xy) agrees with the service's WGS84 output within 3e-8 degrees for all four records.

transform_check: No Atlas transformation: the WGS84 point is Ryhti's own output; an independent pyproj check of the native EPSG:3067 point agrees.
